title: I made a free character expression generator Web App!
author: fyrean

comments.author: fyrean
comments.body:
You can use it for free here: [https://fyrean.itch.io/matxinh](https://fyrean.itch.io/matxinh)

My goal is to create a nice and convenient webapp that anyone can easily use and transform their characters’ expressions! Hence the interface is very streamlined and all the advanced parameters are not shown by default. Hopefully you’ll find it usefull :)

My future plans is to enable batch processing so you can generate multiple expressions with one click.

Also if you just want to run this locally, you can install Comfy UI and this [workflow](https://openart.ai/workflows/DZqWIDYghMS7czb5NTGB)

comments.author: 1studlyman
comments.body: That's really cool. Thank you for sharing.

comments.author: Erdeem
comments.body:
Cool, I'd like to learn how to develop these comfyui workflows myself one day. I just need an original idea. How did you learn? Any guides you recommend?

Also, do you have an estimate on costs associated with hosting a tool like this? I can't imagine it's cheap, especially if it picks up in popularity.

replies.author: fyrean
replies.body:
I didn't develop the comfy ui workflow, but the workflow is quite simple and uses the FaceDetailer custom node which does almost all the work.

The cost is pretty much nothing for now, as I'm hosting using my own PC (it has a 3060 which has more than enough VRAM to house the stable diffusion model and let me do normal stuff like watching youtube and work). When it has more demand I'll rent a [vast.ai](http://vast.ai) server with maybe a 3070 for 7 cents an hour (\~$50 a month).
